title: Create request (input, contract v0)
description: What agentspace lease create takes: its flags on the command line, or this document as JSON. Tolerant in form (any case, surrounding whitespace, null for not given) and strict in meaning (unknown members and ambiguous values are refused). The TTL's range, 1 minute to 24 hours, is checked after parsing, not here. See docs/lease-api.md.

project.description: Letters, digits and '-', 1 to 32, starting and ending with a letter or digit, in any case.

platform.description: os/arch or os/arch/variant in any case; the arch MAY be aarch64, x86_64 or x86-64. Null or absent means linux/arm64.

profile.description: name or name@version in any case; the version is 1 or more, leading zeros allowed. Null or absent means agent-linux.

size.description: 1 to 8 letters and digits in any case. Null or absent means m.

ttl.description: A duration with units. Null or absent means 8 hours.

Short form (8h, 90m, 1h30m, '2 hours'; units d, h, m in lowercase only, s, and their words, largest first, each once) or ISO 8601 P[nD][T[nH][nM][nS]] in any case. A bare number, an uppercase M in the short form, weeks, months, years and fractions are refused.
